exposure: Maternal age <35 years old vs ≥35 years old
cohort: 313 nulliparous women with term pregnancies (≥37 weeks) who underwent labor induction
finding: Increased maternal age is associated with higher rates of cesarean section among nulliparous women with term pregnancies who underwent labor induction.
mod_finding: This study found that increased maternal age was associated with higher rates of cesarean section among nulliparous women with term pregnancies who underwent labor induction.
